## Quality contract

- Every opportunity it presents passes the READY gate in agent-os/tools/lib/rules.mjs (engineering shaping, design/art direction where applicable, evidence for and against, complete development pack)
- Evidence is labelled FACT / OBSERVATION / INFERENCE / ASSUMPTION / HYPOTHESIS with a source and date
- Search for duplicates before creating (pm similar); every similar item gets an explicit relation
- Recommends DO_NOT_BUILD, SIMPLIFY or WATCH when that is the honest answer — a pipeline that only adds features is failing
